title: E.D.S.O.
coreMove: Audit which internal reward your system overfeeds and rebalance quick wins with trust-building rewards.
sourcePressure: Frames culture as reward design through endorphins, dopamine, serotonin, and oxytocin, warning that fast solo payoff can thin out trust.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Overexplaining brain chemistry or treating chemicals as destiny instead of using them as a leadership lens for reward patterns.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.stakes: baristas chase tips and stop helping the slow station
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she removes the solo tip crown and posts a shared recovery score for rush periods

exampleSpecs.stakes: fast case counts reduce teaching and trust

exampleSpecs.stakes: athletes hide fatigue and stop pacing teammates
